mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a contractor for stone patio installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for stone patio installation, prioritize experience, reputation, and proper licensing. Look for contractors specializing in natural stone, with a portfolio of completed projects. Verify their C-27 Landscape Contractor's license (or relevant general contractor license) and ensure they are insured. Obtain multiple quotes, ensuring each includes a detailed breakdown of costs, materials, and a project timeline. Communication and a clear understanding of your vision are also crucial for a successful partnership.
